title: chore: migrate DDP callers to REST endpoints (used methods with REST replacement)

target.summary: The `/v1/chat.getThreadMessages` REST endpoint defaults to a 50-message pagination limit, unlike the original DDP method. Querying it without pagination parameters causes threads containing more than 50 messages to be truncated and fail to render subsequent messages.
notes: faulty getThreadMessages call querying the REST endpoint without pagination parameters
definition of the REST endpoint hook that replaced the unpaginated DDP method
